verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for a payments platform, but the evidence shows no user-definable scheduler or recurring workflow feature. The cited items cover one-off API actions (Terminal API, Management API), event-driven webhooks, an account setting to prompt for a tip on every payment, and payout-method settings. None of these is a recurring schedule the user can configure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
